description: This Go source file defines the Operation management subsystem within the 'orchestrator' package. It provides mechanisms to create, track, list, retrieve, complete, and wait for asynchronous operations identified by unique IDs with concurrency control. It implements an in-memory operation manager using a map protected by mutexes, and includes error handling for not found, timeout, and incomplete operation scenarios.

classes.name: mapOMOperationEntry
classes.description: Represents an individual operation's state, result, mutex, and synchronization channel within the MapOM manager.

classes.name: MapOM
classes.description: Implements the OperationManager interface using an in-memory map of operations, guarded by read-write mutexes, supporting operation lifecycle management.

methods.name: NotFoundOperationError
methods.description: Custom error type for not found operations.

methods.name: OperationWaitTimeoutError
methods.description: Custom error type for timeout during wait.

methods.name: OperationNotDoneError
methods.description: Custom error indicating an operation is not completed.

methods.name: NewMapOM
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new MapOM instance with default UUID factory.

methods.name: MapOM.New
methods.description: Creates a new operation with a unique ID, adding it to the manager.

methods.name: MapOM.ListRunning
methods.description: Returns a list of currently running (not completed) operations.

methods.name: MapOM.Get
methods.description: Retrieves an operation by name, returning an error if not found.

methods.name: MapOM.GetResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of an operation if it is complete.

methods.name: MapOM.Complete
methods.description: Marks an operation as completed and stores its result.

methods.name: MapOM.Wait
methods.description: Waits for an operation to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: MapOM.getOperationEntry
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve an operation entry by name with concurrency safety.
